info.description: Sail a ring of 24 treasure islands, dig up as much gold as your hold can take and race it home before a wandering storm or a greedy rival takes it off you. First captain with ten treasure in the harbour wins.
info.ruleText:
Several pirate ships cruise a ring of 24 lonely islands looking for buried treasure. Dig it up, load it on board and be the first to bring ten pieces safely into your own harbour - while a wandering storm, greedy rivals and your own overloaded hold do their best to stop you.

On your turn you roll one die. A number sails your ship that many islands onward; the storm symbol lets you drift the storm across the board instead. Every island you stop at does something: islands with a green number let you choose how much treasure to take, a red 2 forces two on you, and islands without a chest are where captains rob each other. Your hold takes seven pieces at most - take one too many and everything sinks.

Only your own harbour can be entered, and only once per lap, so timing your run home is the heart of the game.
info.helpText:
Goal

Be the first captain to bring 10 treasure home. The number in your harbour (and the anchor next to your seat) is what you have landed so far.

Setup

Everybody clicks a seat, then somebody presses the anchor button on the right. All ships return to their harbours and a random captain starts.

Your turn

Press the big dice button on the right (or click the die itself).
  • A number - your ship sails that many islands clockwise, following the dark arrows. If your own harbour is on the way you are asked whether you want to sail in, unload and start a new voyage; the rest of the move is then lost.
  • The storm symbol - you may first sail on one single island, then you drift the storm against the sailing direction (the white wind arrows): up to 5 islands with 2 players, 4 with 3 players, 3 with 4 players (0 = leave it).

The 28 spaces

  • Open chest, green number - load as much treasure as you like, up to that number. The dialog suggests the largest safe amount.
  • Closed chest, red 2 - greed wins: you must load 2 treasure.
  • Island without a chest - if a rival ship is moored here you may steal up to 2 treasure from it, or push up to 2 of yours onto it to make it capsize. Choose 0 to do nothing.
  • Harbour - one per colour, only its owner may sail in.
  • A ship can carry at most 7 treasure. Load more and it capsizes: the whole cargo sinks and you sail on with an empty hold.

When the storm stops on ships

The wind wheel in the middle of the sea is spun and shows what happens to every ship on that island:
  • Wind - the ships are simply blown one island onward.
  • Three figures - each hit ship hands one treasure to every other captain.
  • Anchor - lucky! The hit ships reach their own harbour and unload at once.
  • Splash - two treasure per hit ship wash into the sea.

Shorter game

Agree on fewer than 10 treasure before you start and simply stop when somebody reaches that number.
